# sccmusixxplugin — SCC-Musixx (MSX)

**SCC-Musixx**, Tyfoon-Software's 1990 tracker for Konami's **SCC** wavetable
sound chip on the MSX.

Extensions: `.SNG` (uppercase — the lowercase `.sng` is C64 GoatTracker or a UADE
Richard Joseph tune, routed elsewhere)

## How it works

The original SCC-MUSIXX replay routine runs on an embedded Z80 core, with its SCC
register writes driving the **emu2212** SCC emulator.
